summary: AKUPUNKTØR STINE SOLBERG (org. no. 980 433 099) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Kongsvinger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1999-01-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 86.960 (Aktiviteter innenfor tradisjonell, komplementær og alternativ medisin); it has 0 registered employees.
